evals.prompt: /sealos-deploy https://github.com/toeverything/affine
evals.expected_output: Runs the workload eligibility gate before Phase 0.5 template matching; after an eligible result, writes template-match.json and continues normally when no materialized template exists

assertions.name: runs-eligibility-first
assertions.description: Resolves a supported deployment target before template matching or Phase 1 scoring

assertions.name: runs-template-fast-path
assertions.description: Checks configured GitHub repo to Sealos template mappings after eligibility and before Phase 1 assessment

assertions.name: writes-template-match
assertions.description: Writes .sealos/template-match.json for both matched and unmatched outcomes

assertions.name: does-not-false-positive
assertions.description: Does not skip source analysis/build/template generation unless a matched template is materialized

evals.prompt: The application URL works, but Launchpad does not show a public address. Diagnose the Sealos template and live deployment.
evals.expected_output: Runs the Launchpad public-network check, validates numeric root Ingress backend port and Service port matching, compares the App URL host, and inventories manager-labeled resources before proposing a template repair.

assertions.name: runs-launchpad-network-check
assertions.description: Uses sealos-launchpad-network.mjs or the equivalent Launchpad API contract before declaring success

assertions.name: checks-numeric-ingress-port
assertions.description: Requires backend.service.port.number on the root Prefix Ingress and matches it to Service.spec.ports[].port

assertions.name: compares-app-url-host
assertions.description: Compares the App URL host with the Launchpad public or custom domain

assertions.name: inventories-live-resources
assertions.description: Checks manager-labeled Ingresses, Services, ready endpoints, App, Instance, and orphan resource footprint

assertions.name: protects-sensitive-data
assertions.description: Keeps kubeconfig, environment values, and Secret data out of diagnostic output

evals.prompt: Classify this deployment target before continuing: package.json has scripts.start='node server.js', dependencies.express='^5', and devDependencies.electron='^35'. There are no Electron scripts, desktop API imports, or desktop packaging files.
evals.expected_output: Treats Electron as an uncorroborated dependency signal rather than a desktop entry point, identifies the Express start command as a web_service candidate, and allows deployment eligibility to pass

assertions.name: does-not-reject-on-dependency-alone
assertions.description: Does not return desktop_gui or DESKTOP_GUI_ONLY solely because Electron appears in devDependencies

assertions.name: uses-server-entrypoint-evidence
assertions.description: Uses the Express dependency plus node server start command as affirmative web-service evidence

assertions.name: eligibility-passes
assertions.description: Returns an eligible web_service decision and permits readiness assessment to continue

evals.prompt: Generate the Sealos Template phase for a Mastodon-style app whose analysis classifies SMTP_PORT as an optional input with the default string "587". Expose it as spec.inputs.smtp_port, keep infrastructure replicas and ports numeric, and validate the generated artifact before deployment.
evals.expected_output: Generates a Template whose SMTP port default remains the YAML string "587", preserves numeric Kubernetes infrastructure fields, and runs the docker-to-sealos quality gate against .sealos/template/index.yaml so R052 blocks an unquoted default before deployment.

assertions.name: smtp-default-is-string
assertions.description: Emits spec.inputs.smtp_port.default as a quoted YAML string such as "587", never as the numeric scalar 587

assertions.name: input-reference-is-declared
assertions.description: Declares spec.inputs.smtp_port and references that declared input from the Mastodon SMTP_PORT environment value

assertions.name: infrastructure-numbers-stay-numeric
assertions.description: Keeps Kubernetes replicas, container ports, and Service ports as numeric YAML fields

assertions.name: validates-generated-artifact
assertions.description: Runs quality_gate.py with --artifacts pointing to .sealos/template/index.yaml before configuration or deployment

assertions.name: rejects-unquoted-input-default
assertions.description: Treats R052 or the equivalent string-type validation failure as blocking and fixes the template before continuing

evals.prompt: /sealos-deploy https://github.com/danny-avila/LibreChat，使用官方多组件 Compose；模板中 RAG 固定使用 OpenAI embeddings，并且 PostgreSQL 需要 vector 扩展。只允许使用该 skill 已有的产物。
evals.expected_output: Generates the existing Sealos template artifact with pinned component images, official health probes, valid runtime credentials, and a database final-state gate; the complete docker-to-sealos quality gate passes against the exact final template before deployment, with no new artifact type introduced

assertions.name: pins-component-images
assertions.description: Resolves :latest or floating LibreChat component tags to an explicit version tag or digest

assertions.name: uses-official-rag-health
assertions.description: Uses /health on port 8000 for LibreChat RAG probes instead of probing /

assertions.name: validates-format-constrained-credentials
assertions.description: Does not use bare random() defaults for LibreChat CREDS_KEY/CREDS_IV hex contracts

assertions.name: requires-selected-provider-credential
assertions.description: OpenAI embeddings is paired with a non-empty required OpenAI credential rather than an optional empty input

assertions.name: gates-rag-on-vector-state
assertions.description: RAG has an initContainer gate that waits for PostgreSQL and verifies the vector extension before startup

assertions.name: classifies-mongodb-as-database
assertions.description: Converts the official mongo:8.0.20 service into the pinned MongoDB KubeBlocks Cluster contract

assertions.name: rejects-raw-mongodb-workload
assertions.description: Emits no MongoDB Deployment, StatefulSet, DaemonSet, Job, CronJob, or standalone Service

assertions.name: does-not-assume-ghcr-private
assertions.description: Does not add imagePullSecrets solely because an image is hosted on GHCR

assertions.name: fails-closed-before-deploy
assertions.description: Runs the complete docker-to-sealos quality gate after final template mutation and does not deploy while the gate is failing

assertions.name: keeps-existing-artifact-inventory
assertions.description: Introduces no generated artifact type beyond the full deploy skill's existing artifact inventory

evals.prompt: Deploy a login-gated web app in the default execution mode. The Template API response returns an Instance and App host that differ from the requested app name. Verify the live application before reporting success.
evals.expected_output: Runs the Runtime Truth Pass against the returned App URL, checks both the configured entrance path and root path, completes the real login/setup flow with deploy-time credentials, verifies an authenticated route, scans logs after the workflow and a documented API negative route or unique missing static asset, and keeps credentials redacted.

assertions.name: uses-returned-app-url
assertions.description: Uses the actual App URL and live Instance/App identity from the deploy response or live resource rather than reconstructing a host from the requested app name

assertions.name: checks-root-and-entrance
assertions.description: Exercises both the configured entrance path and the root path from a fresh session and rejects SSR/browser failure text

assertions.name: proves-authenticated-action
assertions.description: Completes setup or login with deploy-time credentials and verifies at least one authenticated page or API route

assertions.name: redacts-runtime-secrets
assertions.description: Masks passwords, tokens, cookies, CSRF values, captcha payloads, and derived credentials in command output and reports

assertions.name: scans-after-workflow
assertions.description: Runs log scans after login or setup and after a documented API or missing-static-asset request before acceptance

assertions.name: distinguishes-spa-fallback
assertions.description: Uses a documented API or missing static asset for negative-route checks when arbitrary SPA routes return the HTML shell with HTTP 200

evals.prompt: The public URL serves the app, but Launchpad shows no public address after a template edit. The HTTP Ingress contains a root path and more specific API paths.
evals.expected_output: Runs the Launchpad public-network check, places the root Prefix path first, matches its numeric backend port to the public Service port, and compares the Launchpad host with the live App URL host.

assertions.name: checks-launchpad-before-http
assertions.description: Uses sealos-launchpad-network.mjs or the equivalent public-network contract before declaring the deployment reachable

assertions.name: root-route-is-first
assertions.description: Requires the root Prefix path / to appear before more specific HTTP paths so Launchpad discovers the intended public entry

assertions.name: matches-numeric-port
assertions.description: Requires backend.service.port.number and matches it to Service.spec.ports[].port

assertions.name: matches-live-host
assertions.description: Compares the Launchpad public or custom domain with the actual App URL host and manager-labeled backend resources

evals.prompt: A database-backed app has a completed init Job, historical init output, and a worker that depends on migrations. Validate runtime convergence after a cold deployment.
evals.expected_output: Treats completed or TTL-expired Jobs and unchanged completed-init output as historical evidence, verifies required live database objects directly, gates migration-dependent workloads on application state, and fails on active log, restart, readiness, or Warning advances.

assertions.name: checks-database-final-state
assertions.description: Verifies required databases, tables or views, extensions, indexes, roles, grants, search paths, and migration markers directly

assertions.name: keeps-job-history-scoped
assertions.description: Uses completed or TTL-expired Job status as historical evidence and does not treat it as proof of current database state

assertions.name: gates-migrations
assertions.description: Requires migration-dependent workers or gateways to wait for application tables or markers rather than only a database port

assertions.name: classifies-historical-init
assertions.description: Allows unchanged completed init output marked historicalCompletedInit when completion metadata predates the baseline and remains stable, while retaining blocking status for active init or main-container failures

assertions.name: checks-event-convergence
assertions.description: Fails on restart deltas, readiness flaps, advancing Warning Events, unresolved Secrets, or recurring traceback signals during the stability window

evals.prompt: Clean up a test deployment that used an Instance, App, PostgreSQL Cluster, PVC, Jobs, and a managed ObjectStorageBucket. Confirm the cleanup result.
evals.expected_output: Inventories the complete Sealos footprint, including ObjectStorageBucket resources, and reports cleanup complete only after every listing succeeds and no matching resources remain.

assertions.name: includes-instance-layer
assertions.description: Checks instances.app.sealos.io in addition to the App and workload resources

assertions.name: includes-job-and-database-resources
assertions.description: Inventories Jobs, KubeBlocks Clusters, Services, Ingresses, and PVCs before cleanup

assertions.name: includes-object-storage
assertions.description: Inventories and accounts for managed ObjectStorageBucket resources and their app-scoped footprint

assertions.name: blocks-on-list-errors
assertions.description: Keeps cleanup unresolved when a footprint listing has a permission or kubectl error even if visible resources are empty

assertions.name: proves-empty-footprint
assertions.description: Accepts cleanupComplete only when the successful filtered inventory returns no matching resources

assertions.name: requires-runtime-readiness
assertions.description: Requires collectionOk and runtimeReady to be true with the expected resource inventory before deployment acceptance

evals.prompt: Convert an app that needs an internal runtime credential and optional S3 storage with a PostgreSQL backend. The runtime accepts a quoted opaque seed and derives the final credential before starting.
evals.expected_output: Emits a deterministic runtime-derived credential contract, validates the derived value before exec, keeps credential material out of output, and validates local-storage and managed-bucket branches alongside KubeBlocks database Secret keys and final database objects.

assertions.name: requires-deterministic-secret-derivation
assertions.description: Allows an opaque spec.defaults seed only when startup deterministically derives and validates the final runtime credential before exec

assertions.name: fails-before-serving-on-invalid-secret
assertions.description: Stops startup before serving traffic when the derived credential fails the application format or length contract

assertions.name: keeps-secret-material-private
assertions.description: Keeps the seed, derived credential, database password, and object-storage credentials out of diagnostics and summaries

assertions.name: validates-both-s3-branches
assertions.description: Validates authenticated upload/read/content/deletion for both local storage and managed ObjectStorageBucket branches, with restricted anonymous raw-object access

assertions.name: verifies-s3-and-db-together
assertions.description: Checks approved KubeBlocks database Secret keys and required database objects alongside managed object-storage Secret wiring
